parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query.

parameters.name: DstType
parameters.description:
The service to which the destination data source belongs. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute.
- **2**: OSS.
- **3**: ADS.
- **4**: OTS.
- **5**: RDS.
- **6**: SELF_DB.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the task creation period. Format: timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword used to search for tasks. You can search by task name or task ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the task creation period. Format: timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
